tldr: Saturn through the 2nd house pressurizes money, security, values, and self-worth.
body:
When Saturn moves through your 2nd house, it makes money, security, possessions, self-worth, spending, income, and what helps you feel steady harder to ignore. You may notice what feels worth keeping, what costs too much, and what would help life feel more stable.

Limits, responsibilities, commitments, and consequences may be harder to avoid. It can help you build something that holds up because you are finally dealing with the reality of it.

The useful side is that this timing can make the next honest move easier to see. This is useful for making a more honest choice around resources, desire, and value.

The caution: Watch for mistaking pressure for failure, or treating delay as proof that nothing is working. The risk is confusing immediate comfort with real security.

Saturn moves through this house for a long season. Move slowly and take the responsibility seriously. The pressure is showing what needs structure.
